newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Reinsurance votes in dividend reinvestment.
newsitem.headline: Reinsurance votes in dividend reinvestment.

text.p: Reinsurance Australia Corp Ltd said on Thursday that a newly introduced dividend reinvestment plan should allow it to underwrite about a further A$40 million of premiums each year.
Chairman Peter Cadwallader told reporters after the annual general meeting, which approved the plan, that its importance lay in the steady generation of new capital.
"It's really a cumulative effect," he said.
"But we have got a huge chunk of new business in so we are not dismayed by this," Cadwallader said.
Gross written premium in calendar 1996 was A$527.3 million.
Reinsurance Australia said in February it was targetting gross underwritten premium growth of 15 percent in 1997.
The company reported a 31 percent rise in net profit to A$66.6 million for calendar 1996.
